vo.text: Identical suggestions, missing values and stale scans: three things that look like bugs, and are not.
vo.next_text: When the required amount exceeds the daily maximum, every station above the cap lands on the same percentage.

vo.text: When the required amount exceeds the daily maximum, every station above the cap lands on the same percentage.

vo.next_text: A run of identical numbers means the cap is deciding, not the scan.

vo.next_text: Change either number and the ceiling moves, which is the honest fix if the ceiling is too low for your course.
